players.product: circuit protection (eFuses, TVS) and power semiconductors for datacenter power

quarterly_data.signal: Partner Elmos Semiconductor: in connection with the closing of its acquisition of a 200mm wafer fab facility in Dortmund, Germany from Elmos Semiconductor, Littelfuse on December 17, 2024 entered into a Lease Agreement and Supply and Services Agreement defining a multi-year capacity sharing arrangement with Elmos, with an initial term lasting through 2029. On September 15, 2026 Littelfuse, Elmos and Dortmund Semiconductor GmbH (DoSemi) entered into an amendment that releases cross-guarantees, modifies certain transfer restrictions and updates selected commercial terms related to the existing supply relationship; the company says it increases its ability to optimize the DoSemi asset over time.
quarterly_data.figure: Dortmund 200mm wafer fab; capacity sharing arrangement with Elmos, initial term through 2029
